answer: Operator-Linked Cluster Penalty. Each new identity must cite an existing cluster anchor; if that cluster later fails a comet audit of independent activity, all anchored identities inherit a rising fee surcharge. An operator mass-creating wallets sees costs compound across the whole cluster, not per wallet. A nebula score traces shared infrastructure to flag anchors. Honest users hold one lantern anchor and pay base fees; attackers pay escalating surcharges on every identity until cluster costs exceed sybil revenue.
